name: DHL eCom Sweden
author: dhlecomsweden

sections.description:
Streamline your order fulfillment process with DHL eCom Sweden.
Easily print shipping labels, schedule pickups and manage returns all in one place – individually or in bulk.
Ship your orders from Sweden to multiple countries seamlessly, saving time and reducing hassle.
Whether you’re a small merchant or scaling up, we make shipping efficient and stress-free.

For detailed instructions and advanced configuration, visit the documentation.

Features

  • Ship domestically in Sweden and from Sweden to multiple countries
  • Customise flat or dynamic shipping rates in your checkout
  • Connect your DHL account and get your personal rates
  • Shipping services: service points, parcel lockers and home deliveries
  • Print labels & QR-codes, book pickups and manage returns

External services

This plugin connects to DHL’s APIs to provide shipping options from DHL in checkout.
It sends the following data to DHL in order to provide shipping options:

  • Order data: order number, shipping addresses, shipping method
  • Customer data: name, email, phone number
  • Product data: quantity, weight, dimensions, goods value

The plugin receives the following data from DHL’s APIs:

  • Shipping options: service points, parcel lockers, home deliveries
  • Tracking info: tracking number, tracking link

The shipping options are displayed in the checkout and the tracking info is displayed in the order confirmation email. The tracking info is sent automatically when the order is booked in the customer portal.

You need a DHL Freight Customer ID to use this plugin. Not a customer yet? Apply here

This service is provided by “DHL Freight (Sweden) AB”: terms of use, privacy policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dhl-ecom-sweden directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the WooCommerce->DHL eCom Sweden screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Follow the instructions in the external settings to connect your DHL account and set up your shipping rates.
  5. Note: This plugin requires an HTTPS-enabled website to function properly.

  • Fixed: Conflict with Woocommerce Subscriptions

  • Fixed: Currency conversion for multi-currency sites.

  • Added: Support for multilingual sites with international shipping.

1.0.10 – 2025-07-02

  • Added: Support for syncing orders with non-DHL shipping methods.

1.0.9 – 2025-06-12

  • Added: More error logging for external requests

1.0.8 – 2025-06-09

  • Fixed: Handle multiple quantities of the same product in the cart.

1.0.7 – 2025-06-03

  • Fixed: Logger import issue.

1.0.6 – 2025-06-02

  • Added: Enhanced logging support for debugging.

1.0.5 – 2025-06-02

  • Added: Logging support

1.0.4 – 2025-06-02

  • Added: Support for more themes and plugins.

1.0.3 – 2025-02-26

  • Fixed: Issue with orders not syncing to DHL.
  • Added: Workaround for disabled REST API.

1.0.2 – 2025-02-10

  • Fixed: Issue with failing requests when missing API key.

1.0.1 – 2025-02-07

  • Fixed: Issue with rates not being calculated for specific themes.
  • Added: Support for shipping rates in cart
  • Added: Support for Klarna Checkout

1.0.0 – 2025-01-19

  • Initial release of the DHL eCom Sweden plugin.
  • Features include domestic and international shipping, service points, and bulk label printing.
